Title: Cyberpunk Core — Neon System HUD
Desc: Cyberpunk Core is an audio-reactive desktop HUD with centered now-playing artwork, live spectrum visualizers, animated particle fields, seven neon themes, and CPU, memory, and GPU telemetry. Customize the clock, visualizer, HUD layout, and image or video background. Nebula particle-field inspiration: Susbananaa's Nebulaw-wallpaper.
Author: Entity6814
